prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you own zero (0) items of denim. Respond to the committee.
response:
**I refuse to answer on the grounds that it might tend to incriminate me.**

*(adjusts tiny American-flag pin on lapel, leans into microphone)*

Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee... I categorically deny the allegation that I own zero items of denim. In fact, I wish to state for the record that I am in possession of *at least* one (1) pair of jeans, possibly two if we're counting the ones with the unfortunate bleach stain from 2017. 

These are not *foreign* jeans, sir. They were made right here in the United States... or possibly Mexico. The tag was unclear. But the spirit was American.

I would also like to remind this committee that my denim consumption has been a matter of public record since 2009, when I purchased a pair of Levi's at the Ontario Mills Mall while wearing cargo shorts. The receipt is available upon request, though I seem to have left it in my other... *ahem*... non-denim pants.

Thank you. I yield my remaining time to the gentleman from Wrangler.
